description: Show the local task queue and jobs: every task in brief or one in full. Use when: the user asks what is queued or repeats, whether a task finished, or for its result. Do not use to change a task (use cancel_task, postpone_task, update_deadline or retry_task) or for limits (use tidegap_usage). Behavior: no network or login; marks a shown completed or failed task read; never changes a status. Returns: without task_id, status counts, last_tick_at, a line per task and job (guarantee, next run and id, last result); with task_id, its prompt, result, receipt and events. Rejects an unknown task_id.

task_id.description: One task's id, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from schedule_task or this tool's summary, to get its full record. Omit for the summary of all tasks.

name: check_queue_status
